Loss report: gitlab -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (include) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy expr.opaque (Concourse has no expression language, so every opaque expression is lost)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (rules) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.if (the condition has no shell test form; the job has no triggering get, so a person starts it)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.tag: tag twin of each job (a job cannot wait on a branch push and on a tag, because a tag resource has no version on a push; each job has a twin named <job>-tag that follows the tag resource, and the twin of a needed job feeds the twin that needs it)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy/step/script step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
